model_directory_shape.name: model_directory_shape
model_directory_shape.value:
("model_directory"."state" = 'undiscovered' AND "model_directory"."last_attempt_at" IS NULL
        AND "model_directory"."last_success_at" IS NULL AND "model_directory"."failure" IS NULL AND "model_directory"."ignored_model_count" = 0)
      OR ("model_directory"."state" = 'available' AND "model_directory"."last_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "model_directory"."last_success_at" IS NOT NULL AND "model_directory"."failure" IS NULL)
      OR ("model_directory"."state" = 'refresh-failed' AND "model_directory"."last_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "model_directory"."last_success_at" IS NOT NULL AND "model_directory"."failure" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("model_directory"."state" = 'discovery-failed' AND "model_directory"."last_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "model_directory"."last_success_at" IS NULL AND "model_directory"."failure" IS NOT NULL)

model_service_target_shape.name: model_service_target_shape
model_service_target_shape.value:
("model_service"."service_type" = 'custom' AND "model_service"."base_url" IS NOT NULL AND "model_service"."api" IS NOT NULL
        AND "model_service"."target_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("model_service"."service_type" = 'builtin' AND "model_service"."base_url" IS NULL AND "model_service"."api" IS NULL)

model_service_credential_shape.name: model_service_credential_shape
model_service_credential_shape.value:
("model_service_credential"."state" = 'unconfigured' AND "model_service_credential"."api_key_encrypted" IS NULL AND "model_service_credential"."updated_at" IS NULL
        AND "model_service_credential"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "model_service_credential"."validation_model" IS NULL
        AND "model_service_credential"."verification_source" IS NULL)
      OR ("model_service_credential"."state" = 'pending-reverification' AND "model_service_credential"."api_key_encrypted" IS NOT NULL
        AND "model_service_credential"."updated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "model_service_credential"."verified_at" IS NULL
        AND "model_service_credential"."validation_model" IS NULL AND "model_service_credential"."verification_source" IS NULL)
      OR ("model_service_credential"."state" = 'verified' AND "model_service_credential"."api_key_encrypted" IS NOT NULL
        AND "model_service_credential"."updated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "model_service_credential"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "model_service_credential"."verification_source" IS NOT NULL)

model_supplement_shape.name: model_supplement_shape
model_supplement_shape.value:
("model_supplement"."source" = 'manual' AND "model_supplement"."target_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("model_supplement"."source" = 'migration-retention' AND "model_supplement"."target_fingerprint" IS NULL)
